verses.1: For you know, brothers, that the way we came to be with you was not empty.
verses.2: But after suffering and being distressed, as you knew from the stories of Philip, we decided to speak to you about the gospel of God in many ways.
verses.3: For our invitation does not come from deceit or impurity, nor is it a form of deception.
verses.4: But as we have been tested by God to believe in the gospel, we must speak of it in such a way that it does not please human beings, but rather for God, who tests our hearts.
verses.5: For we have never become arrogant in our words, as you know. Nor have we ever acted with excessiveness in our prophecies. God is our witness.
verses.6: Neither seeking glory from men, nor from you, nor from others.
verses.7: They may seem like apostles who are in charge of the land. But in reality, they became weak among you. It’s like when a father gives food to his children.
verses.8: In this way, we hope to be able to share with you not only the gospel of God, but also our own souls, since you have become dear to us.
verses.9: Remember, brothers, the sorrow and suffering we have endured; day and night, we worked hard to not burden you too much. That’s why we brought you the gospel of God.
verses.10: We, as witnesses, and God, have come to be with you in a way that is righteous and fair, and without any harm or injustice.
verses.11: As you know, each of you is like a father to his own children.
verses.12: We pray to you, and we hope that you will indeed follow the will of the good God, who calls you to reign and enjoy His glory.
verses.13: And for this reason, we also thank the God without cease, that by hearing His word from Him, we have come to understand that it is indeed the word of God, and not of human beings. It is the word of God that operates within those who believe in it.
verses.14: For you have become followers of the churches of God, brothers and sisters. You also suffer from the same kinds of afflictions as they do, just as they do so with the Jews.
verses.15: Those who kill Jesus, as well as the prophets and us, and who refuse to worship God. They are opposed by all people.
verses.16: We are to speak to these nations, so that they may be saved and their sins be forgiven. But eventually, anger will overcome them.
verses.17: We, brothers, having been separated from you at an early hour, without seeing your faces or hearts, we still desired very much to see your faces.
verses.18: For we have desired to come to you. I, Paul, along with my fellow believers, was cut off by Satan.
verses.19: For what is our hope, or joy, or pride in this? Or perhaps not even that. It’s before our Lord Jesus in His appearance.
verses.20: For you are our glory and our joy.
